attackers_goals: Attackers may attempt to use the command to discover or add local and domain user accounts. The created accounts are to gain additional access to endpoints within your network.
description: The net command is used to add, delete, and otherwise manage the users on a computer. Adversaries may attempt to use the command to discover or add local and domain user accounts.
investigative_actions: Check whether the command line executed is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it. Check whether the user from the command line is an administrator or other sensitive account.
name: Uncommon user management via net command

variations.name: Uncommon user management via net command by a renamed lolbin
variations.description: The net command is used to add, delete, and otherwise manage the users on a computer. Adversaries may attempt to use the command to discover or add local and domain user accounts. The actor process's PE original file name identifies it as a known lolbin, but its on-disk file name differs, indicating the lolbin was renamed - a technique malware and malicious actors often use to evade detection.
